Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: Relied on and relayed an auto-generated DuckDuckGo snippet that incorrectly stated Levon Julfalakyan’s birth date (October 8, 1987) and attributed it to Wikipedia without opening and verifying the source. This introduced a false date (likely conflating Levon with his son) and could have led to a wrong comparison, though it was later corrected.
